digest.component_or_area: LLM provider qualifier resolution in config layer
propositions: The shape-based regex _PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE decides provider qualification by whether a prefix looks like a provider name rather than whether it is a known provider.
A typo'd configured provider like 'bedrok' is silently accepted during config resolution and only fails much later at provider construction.
Slashed provider names such as gateway/openai are wrongly rejected by the shape regex even though they are valid providers.
Replace the regex with a static KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES frozenset of exactly 25 names and decide qualification by membership, keeping the ':' separator.
split_provider_qualifier must not raise on unknown inline prefixes so colon-bearing Bedrock model ids stay intact as unqualified.

_resolve_target must validate an explicitly configured provider against the set and raise LLMConfigError naming the bad value and valid names, and a drift test keeps the static set a superset of runtime registries.
